commit.subject: LU-20488 mdt: broken lease lock check in mdt_object_lock_internal
commit.message:
LU-20488 mdt: broken lease lock check in mdt_object_lock_internal

mdt_object_lock_internal() incorrectly checks for lease locks so
LDLM_FL_CANCEL_ON_BLOCK is never set for lease locks.

Change-Id: I630aead26bae32be847c4a7222ed76cdff26ff39
Signed-off-by: Andrew Perepechko <andrew.perepechko@hpe.com>
Fixes: 2869f429 ("LU-13668 mdt: change lock mode for lease")
HPE-bug-id: LUS-13312
